description: This file defines the ConnectParticipantClient class, which extends AwsClient, for interacting with the Amazon Connect Participant Service API. It includes method annotations for various operations such as authentication, message handling, and connection management.

classes.name: ConnectParticipantClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Connect Participant Service, providing methods for messaging, connection, and participant management.

methods.name: cancelParticipantAuthentication
methods.description: Cancels participant authentication via the Amazon Connect Participant Service.

methods.name: describeView
methods.description: Describes the current view of a participant.

methods.name: getAuthenticationUrl
methods.description: Gets the authentication URL for a participant.

methods.name: getTranscript
methods.description: Retrieves the transcript for a participant session.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event to a participant.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a participant.
